qualification.status: Cubature 1.12.2-0.1.4.0, built for Cleanroom and Forge from a clean checkout of this commit; 272 Cubature tests per loader (Cleanroom's reported up to date), 80 Cleanroom and 78 Forge lab tests, 0 failures. The four JARs are byte-identical to the 1dc3aaed build; commits after 1dc3aaed change only the lab (Distant Horizons LOD trace and preview survey) and docs. That build, on fresh Riven worlds, passed a PREFETCH flight-and-settle (14,251 unloads and no loads while standing, the 20,538-cube floor), saved blocks of 82,215 cubes away from spawn matching a 9e45a6fa world, the lab generation, maintenance and save contracts under PREFETCH and BASELINE, a BASELINE route whose GC sweep ran at the 201st call, and a step-route full view.
qualification.contents: Version 0.1.4.0 with Orthrus Research as copyright holder and vendor and compile-only build inputs that a standalone clone fetches; since the initial commit, the manual CI workflow's build-input step, deliveryMode as the only delivery input, the periodic autosave as a named provider call, explicit delivery generation timing with run-or-await for work in flight, sender-chosen PacketCubes sizing, a provider and lighting that reach the player cube map only through CubeDemand and SurfaceHeightListener, held teleports kept when a teleport leaves the player in place, PlayerCubeMap, CubeProviderServer and the lab's Python tools split into focused parts, the delivery system in its own core.server.delivery package behind a boundary test, every numeric setting ranged and checked on sync and by the set command, and every test source run on both loaders.
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously
